title: Gracie Abrams Reveals ‘Daughter From Hell’ Album Tracklist
summary: Abrams called the LP her "favorite music" she's ever made.
contentText:
Gracie Abrams revealed the tracklist for her upcoming Daughter From Hell album on Wednesday (June 17). The pop star’s anticipated third LP is set to arrive on July 17.

Daughter From Hell boasts 16 tracks in total, including the project’s lead single “Hit the Wall,” which was released in May and serves as the album’s intro. The track peaked at No. 42 on the  Billboard Hot 100 .

Abrams also posted each song’s runtime on social media, with titles like “Sober,” “Death Wish,” “Knife,” “Men Like You,” “Humming” and “What If It’s Right?” the latter of which features Marcus Mumford and is the longest track on the LP. The singer-songwriter also called “What If It’s Right?” her favorite from the album.

Fans and Abrams’ music peers were excited at the announcement. Rapper Russ chimed in on her Instagram comment section, “Can’t Wait.”

There was also a contingent of fans wondering why the unreleased track titled “Out of Nowhere” didn’t make the cut. “GRACIEEEEE, WHERE IS OUT OF NOWHERE???” one person wrote. Another added: “Excuse meee? No Out of Nowhere? :((“

Abrams called Daughter From Hell her “favorite music” she’s made to date in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter in January.

“It’s definitely my favorite music I’ve ever made, and I feel very closely connected to it,” she said. “I appreciate so much that these albums are time capsules of where I’m at in my life at any given point, but right now it does feel very like me. I hope that whoever finds it, connects with it and that they make it theirs when it’s out one day. But not yet.”

The 26-year-old will embark on The Look at My Life Tour in December, which will take over North American arenas. The trek kicks off on Dec. 2 in Denver with stops in Oakland, Los Angeles, Glendale, Seattle, Portland, Chicago, Nashville, Toronto, Atlanta and Philadelphia. It wraps up with four shows in Brooklyn next March.

Abrams’ last album, The Secret of Us , arrived in June 2024 and peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200.

Find the Daughter From Hell tracklist below and look for the album on July 17.
